title: wellmanifest.agent/report/v1
description: Coordinator-facing agent completion report. Schema and docs only — not a runtime. Does not extend closed wellmanifest/agent v1 (profile/request/run/receipt). Parent coordinators MUST reject a report missing workspaceRoot. Reuses intent.placement home/shape; placement stays optional on existing tickets.

workspaceRoot.description: Exact `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` (or pwd if not a git checkout). Must be the repository that was edited. Must match the user task or the agent STOPs.

gitToplevel.description: Repeat of git rev-parse --show-toplevel. When present, must equal workspaceRoot.

home.description: Same enum as intent.placement.home. ADOPT is not HOME.

filesTouched.description: Repository-relative paths actually edited. Empty is valid for STOP. When allowedPaths is present, each path must match a glob (fail-closed GOV-SCOPE).

allowedPaths.description: Copy of intent.json allowedPaths when known. Optional so old tickets remain compatible.
